title: Design: Picking a Bill To saves at once and shows the payer's name
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Give customer A a name longer than 25 characters (for example "Valders Diesel & Fleet Repair").
  • Have customer B, so there is a customer to pick as Bill To.
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B (an Estimate is fine) that bills itself, so its Bill To reads This customer.
  • Start on the work order page.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p2-06-after-picked.png, bt-p2-08-after-s2-17579.png, bt-p2-07-before-s2-17579.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Bill To field on the customer card.
  2. Click customer A in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list opens.

Step 2:

  • The list closes with no message and no toast.
  • Bill To shows customer A's name in the card's value style.
  • Nothing is added to the work order header or the customer card header.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R5: “Picking a customer saves the Bill To immediately; picking "(this customer)" makes the customer pay for itself.”
  • S3-R2: “The field reads "This customer" when the customer pays for itself, otherwise the Bill To's name.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "2 Bill a work order or part sale to someone else", pictures "Picked" (This build), "S2-17579" (This build), "S2-17579" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p2-06-after-picked.png
  • bt-p2-08-after-s2-17579.png
  • bt-p2-07-before-s2-17579.png

The design's own words:

  • “Nothing is added to the card's header or the work order header.”

Difference: on desktop the design cuts a long name at the card edge with no ellipsis (BT-D06, question 6, held case DV-06).

The attached picture shows the payer's name cut at the card's edge although its note gives the full name; the full name is expected (the cut is asked in question 9).
